_description: Defines which SDLC pipeline phases execute for each ticket classification. Read by the ticket-classification skill to determine the execution plan. The classification result is always shown to the user for confirmation before the pipeline starts.

Hotfix._description: Critical production break. Speed is the priority. No design or planning phases — go straight to implementation with an abbreviated requirements pass.

Bug._description: Non-critical defect with a known root cause. Includes simplify and verification to ensure the fix does not introduce regressions.

Spike._description: Time-boxed investigation to answer a specific technical question or reduce uncertainty. Produces a spike_report.md. No code is shipped.

Story._description: A user-facing feature or behaviour change that is well-understood enough to skip architecture. Includes implementation planning but no formal design review.

Small Feature._description: A contained feature that needs a design but is low enough risk to skip a formal design review and risk assessment.

Large Feature._description: A significant feature with broad impact or architectural complexity. Runs all 10 pipeline phases.
